subject: planner: move base logical plan to logical operator pkg. (#53293)
summary: Refactor-only change: moves the shared logical plan base implementation out of `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop`, adds `LogicalPlan.GetBaseLogicalPlan()` to support safe extraction/casting from core helpers, and introduces `utilfuncp` function pointers initialized in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go` to avoid import cycles. Reviewed key call paths (FindBestTask/CanPushToCop/PushDownTopN/FD & stats derivation/taskMap rollback) and found no remaining correctness/semantics/runtime Blocker/High issues in this commit.
